Each puzzle instance has a task id and a test input grid. Tasks recur across the
stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

  {"action": "finish"}                                   end the instance, once it is over
Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

Scoring: every wrong submission costs 1 and every demo request costs 1. An
instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Build the test grid and replicate the top-left pattern around each 2-shape.
N=27
G=[[4]*N for _ in range(N)]
for c in range(N): G[13][c]=1
for r in range(N): G[r][13]=1
# source
G[3][6]=9
G[4][5]=5; G[4][6]=9
for r in (5,6):
    G[r][4]=3; G[r][5]=2; G[r][6]=2; G[r][7]=1; G[r][8]=1
# target blocks
for r in (5,6):
    for c in (20,21): G[r][c]=2
for r in range(19,23):
    for c in range(4,8): G[r][c]=2
for r in (20,21):
    for c in (19,20): G[r][c]=2
src=[(r,c,G[r][c]) for r in range(27) for c in range(27) if G[r][c] not in (4,1) and r<13 and c<13]
# source color1 is also motif data; explicitly take source bbox's all non-background cells.
src=[(r,c,G[r][c]) for r in range(3,7) for c in range(4,9) if G[r][c]!=4]
# target descriptors: anchor (r,c), target size, flip vertical, flip horizontal
for ar,ac,size,fy,fx in [(5,20,1,False,True),(19,4,2,True,False),(20,19,1,True,True)]:
    for r,c,col in src:
        dy,dx=r-5,c-5
        if fy: dy=1-dy
        if fx: dx=1-dx
        for rr in range(ar+dy*size, ar+(dy+1)*size):
            for cc in range(ac+dx*size, ac+(dx+1)*size):
                # write source pattern (includes the seed-colored 2 region)
                G[rr][cc]=col
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in G))
print('dims',len(G),len(G[0]),'src',src)
